section_summary.extract_value: This section describes preliminary analyses and statistical procedures for a single study examining relationships between body appreciation (BAS), BMI, and sexual function. The text reports that BMI was correlated with age and body appreciation, and that body appreciation was correlated with several subscales of the Female Sexual Function Index. Data were examined for statistical assumption violations and outliers, with logarithmic transformation applied to BMI to achieve normality.
